title: Small, Simple, but Only Produced Shakes for Me
text:
Small, Simple, but Only Produced Shakes for Me. [[VIDEOID:bb6709753499f3784cdd93e032970cd3]] My favorite snack, by far, is ice cream. Purchasing tubs of ice cream at the store is as common for me as buying milk and bread- it’s a staple good, as far as I am concerned. It makes sense that, given my love of this sweet treat, that we would give it a go at home and that desire convinced me to try this Quencch Ice Cream Maker.

There are only a few detachable parts with this ice cream maker. To prep, you need to place the bowl in your freezer first, to make sure it’s ready. You then mix the ingredients, set the timer, and let the mixing begin. Once finished, you place in the freezer a little longer and serve.

This ice cream maker does make some noise, but all ice cream makers make noise and the decibel level here isn’t that bad. The unit is on the small size, too, which means it takes up little counter space and it makes just under two quarts of ice cream. The problem is, the ice cream won’t properly freeze. We tried it many times and couldn’t make it work. At first, I thought maybe the bowl wasn’t left in the freezer long enough before mixing, so we tried again after leaving it overnight. It still wouldn’t work. We used the recipes that come with the machine; still no luck. The mixture was still edible, but it was more like a thick shake, not the sweet, creamy ice cream I was hoping for.

I may have received a defective unit, I’m not sure. Anyway, it looks like it’s back to buying ice cream at the store for me. I will continue to look for an ice cream maker, probably one a little larger than this one, and give it another try in the future.
